title: record_document_link input
description: Records the link and status of a document the owner's own AI tool wrote, for example a wiki page. The product never writes the document and never assumes the owner's write succeeded: it stores what the caller reports. The first recorded link creates the row.
$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 9). For a document type with Current Needs Person = yes (C22), current from an AI client is stored as draft until the person confirms on a confirmation card.

documentLinkId.description: Update this link. Leave out to record a new one.

url.description: Opens the document. Checked against the link kind's Url Pattern and the forbidden URL patterns.

statusMeaning.description: The status the caller reports. How far an AI client may set it is the Tool Policy's Max AI State.

lastUpdatedOn.description: When the document was last updated.

documentOwnerObjectId.description: The document owner. Leave out for the caller.

linkKindKey.description: A link kind of the document category.
